title: Protein-RNA Binding Measurement Using Double Filter-Binding Assays
author: Vega-Badillo, Zamore, et al.

steps.title: Prepare buffers and inhibitor cocktail
steps.instruction: Make Buffers A, B, C, D, E, and F at the listed final concentrations and volumes, and prepare a 100× protein inhibitor cocktail; store buffers without DTT at 20‑25 °C for up to 3 months and the inhibitor cocktail at 4 °C for immediate use or aliquot at –20 °C for up to 6 months.

substeps.instruction: Buffer A (250 mL total): 10 mM HEPES‑KOH pH 7.9, 10 mM potassium acetate, 1.5 mM magnesium acetate, 0.5 mM DTT, 0.01 % CHAPS, bring to volume with nuclease‑free water.
Buffer B (250 mL total): 300 mM HEPES‑KOH pH 7.9, 1.4 M potassium acetate, 30 mM magnesium acetate, 0.5 mM DTT, 0.01 % CHAPS, bring to volume with nuclease‑free water.
Buffer C (50 mL total): 30 mM HEPES‑KOH pH 7.9, 1.5 mM potassium acetate, 120 mM magnesium acetate, 2 mM DTT, 0.01 % CHAPS, 0.5 mL glycerol (80 % w/v stock), bring to volume with nuclease‑free water.
Buffer D (45.3 mL total): 30 mM HEPES‑KOH pH 7.9, 1.5 mM potassium acetate, 120 mM magnesium acetate, 2 mM DTT, 0.01 % CHAPS, bring to volume with nuclease‑free water.
Buffer E (7.7 mL total): 30 mM HEPES‑KOH pH 7.9, 1.5 mM potassium acetate, 40 mM magnesium acetate, 2 mM DTT, 0.01 % CHAPS, bring to volume with nuclease‑free water.
Buffer F (27.7 mL total): 30 mM HEPES‑KOH pH 7.9, 1.5 mM potassium acetate, 20 mM magnesium acetate, 2 mM DTT, 0.01 % CHAPS, bring to volume with nuclease‑free water.

100× Protein Inhibitor Cocktail (10 mL): 1.2 g AEBSF (120 mg/mL), 0.01 g aprotinin (1 mg/mL), 0.07 g bestatin (7 mg/mL), 0.018 g E‑64 (0.8 mg/mL), 0.024 g leupeptin (2.4 mg/mL); add nuclease‑free water to 10 mL, store at 4 °C (short‑term) or –20 °C (long‑term).

steps.title: Grow FLAG‑AGO2‑expressing HEK293T cells
steps.instruction: Expand HEK293T cells that stably overexpress mouse AGO2 with an N‑terminal 3XFLAG tag; five 95 %‑confluent 100‑cm² dishes typically yield ~100 fmol miRNA‑loaded AGO2.

steps.title: Harvest cells from culture dishes
steps.instruction: For each dish, discard media, add ~5 mL ice‑cold PBS, scrape cells into PBS, and pool all cells into a single 50‑mL tube.

steps.title: Pellet and wash cell pellets
steps.instruction: Centrifuge pooled cells at 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant, wash pellet once with ~50 mL ice‑cold PBS, centrifuge again at 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, then remove all supernatant.

steps.title: Swelling and lysis of cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in twice its volume of Buffer A supplemented with 1× Protein Inhibitor Cocktail, incubate on ice 20 min, then lyse on ice with a Dounce homogenizer (40 strokes, tight B‑type pestle).

steps.title: Clarify lysate and collect S100 extract
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate at 2,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C; transfer supernatant, add 0.11 vol Buffer B (with inhibitor), mix gently, then ultracentrifuge at 100,000 × g for 20 min at 4 °C. Collect the supernatant (S100 extract).

steps.title: Adjust glycerol and store S100
steps.instruction: Add 0.32 vol ice‑cold Buffer C (with inhibitor) to the S100 extract to reach a final 20 % (w/v) glycerol concentration, mix gently, aliquot, flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C (up to 6 months).

steps.title: Capture FLAG‑AGO2 on anti‑FLAG beads
steps.instruction: Use 20 µL anti‑FLAG M2 paramagnetic beads per mL S100; wash beads three times with 1 mL ice‑cold Buffer D + inhibitor; add S100 to beads, rotate 2 h at 4 °C; wash beads three times with 1 mL room‑temperature Buffer D + inhibitor.

steps.title: Load synthetic miR‑449a guide
steps.instruction: Incubate the FLAG‑AGO2‑bound beads with 1 µM 5′‑phosphorylated synthetic miR‑449a (5′‑UGG CAG UGU AUU GUU AGC UGG U) in 250 µL Buffer D, rotating 1 h at 37 °C; then wash beads three times with 1 mL room‑temperature Buffer D.

steps.title: Elute AGO2‑RISC complexes
steps.instruction: Rotate beads with 100 ng·µL⁻¹ 3XFLAG peptide in 400 µL Buffer D for 1 h at 20‑25 °C; collect eluate on ice, repeat elution, and combine both eluates (contains unloaded AGO2 and AGO2 loaded with guide).

steps.title: Purify RISC using biotinylated capture oligo
steps.instruction: Bind 20 µL streptavidin Dynabeads per mL S100 to a biotinylated 2′‑O‑methyl capture oligo (5′‑GAU CAA CAA UAA CCC ACC ACU GCC UAU AGA) per manufacturer’s protocol; incubate assembled RISC (from previous step) with the beads, rotating 1 h at 20‑25 °C (or overnight 12‑18 h at 4 °C).

substeps.instruction: Wash beads five times with 1 mL Buffer D, then five times with 1 mL Buffer E.

Elute RISC with 10 µM biotinylated competitor oligo (5′‑TCT ATA GGC AGT GGT GGG TTA TTG TTG ATC) in 100 µL Buffer F, rotating 1 h at 37 °C; collect supernatant and repeat elution, then combine eluates.
Remove excess competitor by rotating the combined eluate with 250 µL streptavidin Dynabeads for 15 min at 20‑25 °C.
Dialyze the supernatant against three 3 h changes of a 3,000‑fold excess of Buffer D containing 20 % glycerol at 4 °C.
Aliquot 10 µL portions on ice, flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Quantify RISC concentration by northern blot
steps.instruction: Run miR‑449a guide standards (0.5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10, 25, 50 nM in Buffer D + 20 % glycerol) and the purified RISC on a denaturing 15 % polyacrylamide gel (19 × 16 cm, 0.4 mm); transfer RNA to a Hybond‑XL membrane by semi‑dry transfer at 20 V for 1 h; crosslink with 0.16 M EDC in 0.13 M 1‑methylimidazole (pH 8.0) at 60 °C for 1 h; pre‑hybridize in Church Buffer (1 % BSA, 1 mM EDTA, 0.5 M phosphate, 7 % SDS) at 37 °C for 1 h; add 25 pmol 5′‑^32P‑DNA probe (5′‑ACC AGC TAA CAA TAC ACT GCC A) in Church Buffer and hybridize overnight (12‑18 h) at 37 °C; wash twice with 2× SSC + 0.1 % SDS and twice with 1× SSC + 0.1 % SDS at 37 °C for 15 min each; air‑dry membrane and expose to a storage phosphor screen.

steps.title: Calculate fraction of active RISC
steps.instruction: Using ImageJ or ImageQuant TL, measure signals of protein‑bound RNA (Sbound) on nitrocellulose, unbound RNA (Sunbound) on nylon, and background (b) with identical ROI sizes; compute fraction bound f = (Sbound − b) / [(Sbound − b) + (Sunbound − b)]; subtract the f value from a no‑RISC control; plot f versus r = [RISC]/[targetRNA]; fit the curve to the quadratic Hill equation f(r)=fmax×(r+KD+n−√((r+KD+n)²−4 r n))/2 n.

steps.title: Determine KD by double filter‑binding assay
steps.instruction: Quantify fraction bound as above and fit the data to the Morrison equation for tight binding: f([ET]) = ([ET]+[ST]+KD − √(([ET]+[ST]+KD)² − 4 [ET][ST])) / (2 [ST]), where [ET] is total enzyme (RISC) concentration and [ST] is total target RNA concentration.

steps.title: Analyze RBNS sequencing data
steps.instruction: Download demultiplexed Illumina files; retain reads containing “TGG” at positions 21‑23; trim the 3′ adapter (5′‑TGG AAT TCT CGG GTG CCA AGG); discard reads with any base quality <20 or containing “N”; convert the remaining 20‑nt sequences to RNA (replace T with U); append constant flanking sequences: if no cDNA blocking oligos, add 5′‑GAG UUC UAC AGU CCG ACG AUC and 3′‑UGG AAU UCU CGG GUG CCA A; if blocking oligos were used, add 5′‑GAUC and 3′‑UGGA; scan each read for a single binding motif (discard reads with multiple or overlapping motifs); estimate KD values with the provided code as described in the README.
